name: Aquatic Druid
summary: A guardian of rivers, lakes, and oceans who adapts to aquatic terrain and the crushing deep.

featureOverrides.summary: Influence creatures with a swim speed or the aquatic or water subtype, including mindless creatures with Intelligence 2 or less.

features.name: Aquatic Adaptation
features.summary: In aquatic terrain, add half Druid level to initiative and key exploration skills and leave no trail.

features.name: Natural Swimmer
features.summary: Gain a swim speed equal to half your land speed.

features.name: Resist Ocean's Fury
features.summary: Gain +4 on saves against water spells and abilities of aquatic or water creatures.

features.name: Wild Shape
features.summary: Gain Wild Shape using an effective Druid level two lower.
features.scaling: 1 use per day; effective Druid level -2

features.name: Wild Shape
features.summary: Gain a second daily use and forms available to a 6th-level Druid.

features.name: Wild Shape
features.summary: Gain a third daily use and forms available to an 8th-level Druid.

features.name: Wild Shape
features.summary: Gain a fourth daily use and forms available to a 10th-level Druid.

features.name: Wild Shape
features.summary: Gain a fifth daily use and forms available to a 12th-level Druid.

features.name: Wild Shape
features.summary: Gain an eighth daily use; the reduced effective level does not reach at-will Wild Shape.

features.name: Seaborn
features.summary: Gain the aquatic subtype, amphibious trait, a full land-speed swim speed, and protection from cold climates.

features.name: Deep Diver
features.summary: Gain DR against slashing, piercing, grappling, and crushing damage and ignore deep-water pressure.
features.scaling: DR equal to half Druid level
